title: Algebraic descent retaining compatible local formal comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ a coherent module, $N$ a coherent formal module, and $\delta:N\to H^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be an open cover and let coherent $H_i$ have underlying module equal to $H|_{U_i}$. Let $\gamma_i:(H^\wedge)|_{U_i}\cong H_i^\wedge$ carry each restricted quotient projection to the quotient projection of $H_i$ after that equality. Suppose on each $U_i$ a coherent $F_i$, arrow $a_i:F_i\to H_i$, and isomorphism $\beta_i:N|_{U_i}\cong F_i^\wedge$ factor the restricted $\delta$, and some positive power of $J|_{U_i}$ annihilates the actual kernel and cokernel of $a_i$. Then there are a global coherent $F$, arrow $a:F\to H$, and local inverse-system isomorphisms $\epsilon_i:N|_{U_i}\cong(F^\wedge)|_{U_i}$ on the over-site [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules]. Their hom components agree on every open contained in $U_i\cap U_j$, and $\delta_n|_{U_i}=\epsilon_{i,n}\,a^\wedge_n|_{U_i}$ at every level. For each $i$ there are a coherent $F_i$, arrow $a_i:F_i\to H_i$, and module isomorphism $e_i:F|_{U_i}\cong F_i$ intertwining the restricted $a$ with $a_i$ and the target identification; some positive power of $J|_{U_i}$ annihilates $\ker(a_i)$ and $\operatorname{coker}(a_i)$. The conclusion neither glues the $\epsilon_i$ globally nor asserts annihilation for the restricted actual global kernel and cokernel.

proof.text: Choose the supplied local triples. Restrict to intersections: coherence and actual kernels and cokernels commute with restriction; ideal powers and ideal-module products restrict to the corresponding local products. Thus each restricted arrow retains its supplied power bounds. Identify their completions with the restriction of N by the canonical normalized completion-restriction comparison. Normalization of gamma makes their completed arrows to the restricted H agree.

Apply torsion-controlled hom lifting to the completed comparison and its inverse on each intersection. Completion extensionality together with the map to H identifies both composites with identities. It also identifies the composite comparisons on triple intersections with the direct comparison, giving the cocycle.

Use module-sheaf descent to glue the local sources, and morphism descent to glue their arrows into H. Coherence is local, so the glued source is coherent. The gluing isomorphisms e identify each restricted global arrow with a supplied local ai after the target equality hHlocal. Retain ai and its bound, without asserting any bound for the global kernel or cokernel.

Compose each local beta with the inverse of the completed source gluing isomorphism and the canonical completion-restriction comparison. Transfer the resulting local system isomorphism to the over-site using the standard equivalence with modules on the open subscheme. On each open contained in a pairwise intersection, the hom components agree by the defining completed comparison. The local factorization of delta and naturality of the normalized comparison give its componentwise equation with the restriction of completion(a). No global formal-system isomorphism is glued at this step.

theorem torsionControlled_algebraization_local_descent
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (Hlocal : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (hHlocal : ∀ i, (Hlocal i).obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj H.obj)
    (γ : ∀ i, ((completion X J).obj H).obj ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) (Hlocal i).obj)
    (hγ : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ),
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) H.obj) ≫ (γ i).hom.app (op n) =
        eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap (U i).ι) (n + 1) (Hlocal i).obj)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, ∃ (F : CoherentModules (U i).toScheme) (a : F ⟶ Hlocal i)
      (β : N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) F.obj),
      Functor.whiskerRight δ.hom (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι) ≫ (γ i).hom =
        β.hom ≫ formalCompletionMap (J.comap (U i).ι) a.hom ∧
      (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel a.hom)) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (cokernel a.hom)))) :
    ∃ (F : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H)
      (ε : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (U i) ≅
        ((completion X J).obj F).obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (U i)),
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
        ((ε i).hom.app n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) =
          ((ε j).hom.app n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i : ι), (δ.hom.app n).over (U i) =
        (ε i).hom.app n ≫ (((completion X J).map a).hom.app n).over (U i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ (Fi : CoherentModules (U i).toScheme) (ai : Fi ⟶ Hlocal i)
        (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj F.obj ≅ Fi.obj),
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map a.hom ≫
          eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm = e.hom ≫ ai.hom ∧
        ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
          IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
            (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel ai.hom)) ∧
          IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
            (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2
            (cokernel ai.hom)))
